verdict.rationale: Factory's code-review CI docs say Droid analyzes pull and merge requests and posts its findings as inline comments. The docs overview frames code review as running 'on autopilot across your repos', which supports automatic review of every PR. Missing for 10: documented trigger and configuration details showing reviews run on every PR (e.g., webhook or CI setup, coverage of all repos), and independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments

citations.quote: Droid analyzes pull requests and merge requests, identifies issues, and posts feedback as inline comments.
Put code review, QA, and documentation on autopilot across your repos.
